premises.text: Layer industry cannot know chick sex before hatch, so billions of day-old male chicks are incubated then killed
premises.evidence_span: every year we send to be incubated, hatched, and then killed 7 billion day-old male chicks

premises.text: A non-invasive device scans through the eggshell pre-incubation to detect male versus female eggs
premises.evidence_span: our device capable of scanning the egg through the eggshell in a non-invasive way pre-incubation at the speed of light

premises.text: Male-identified eggs are not incubated and can be sold as eggs instead
premises.evidence_span: It is not going to be incubated, and it will be sold as an egg

premises.text: A commercial sex-detectable breed of layers that lay sex-detectable eggs is under development
premises.evidence_span: creating a commercial sex-detectable breed of layers which lay sex-detectable eggs

value.text: Count chickens before they hatch—saving money, chicks, and turning waste into product
value.evidence_span: It's saving billions of dollars, billions of chicks, and creating a product out of waste

creating a commercial sex-detectable breed of layers which lay sex-detectable eggs
